label: OpenCorporates
terms_note: opencorporates.com answers 403 to fetches (no robots.txt served); the REST API 0.4 needs an API token (free for open-data / public-benefit use, paid commercial); data is share-alike licensed.

fields.name: api_token
fields.help: OpenCorporates API token ('available from your account page on OpenCorporates'), sent as the api_token query parameter on every request.

adapter.rate_note: No per-second figure on the page; the quota is per account ('By default you're allowed up to 200 requests per month, and 50 requests per day', more on paid plans).

me.note: GET /account_status returns the plan, expiry and calls_remaining (today / this_month) for the token.

search.note: Name search ('companies whose name matches the given search term'); `country` maps to country_code. `country` in the result is the OpenCorporates jurisdiction_code (ISO alpha-2, or alpha-2 plus subdivision such as us_de). Company numbers are only unique per jurisdiction: pass `<jurisdiction_code>/<company_number>` (raw.company.jurisdiction_code + raw.company.company_number) to get_company. per_page max 100, page ≤ 100. industry_codes[] is documented but its inner shape is not, so `industry` stays in raw.

evidence: probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
